name: Steal This Business
description: Takes an existing startup that works, pulls apart the mechanics, and hands back a separate business you could actually start — including the entry wedge and a blunt read on whether it is worth it. Aimed at people at the deciding stage, not at anyone wanting validation for a plan already underway.

official.title: Steal This Business by aditya
official.description: Reverse-engineers a successful startup into a concrete independent business to build. For founders who want the steal, the wedge, and an honest verdict...
